lines.text: It’s project time! Retell a fairy tale in ScratchJr: storyboard it, use at least two pages, give it a beginning, middle and end, and make the characters talk and move.
The Three Little Pigs, Goldilocks, the Gingerbread Man… pick one you know well.
Draw the beginning, middle and end in three boxes.
Use at least two pages, like the forest and the house.
Give your characters their famous lines!
The gingerbread man says “Run, run!”, runs right 4, hops, and says “Can’t catch me!”.
As fast as you can — you can’t catch him!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
